requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6026--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6026--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2511-2728-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2511-2728-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2511-2728-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

654-1308-2557-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-6488-6572.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal excess noncombat damage to the creature mentioned above.
1775-6488-6572.description:
Activate Deathless Angel by paying {W}{W}, giving a creature an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to the indestructible creature.
Toralf triggers, dealing damage equal to the excess to an opponent.
Fear of Burning Alive triggers, dealing damage equal to the damage Toralf dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 3.
1775-6488-6572.notes: Deathless Angel can be omitted if the opponent happens to control an indestructible creature.

4289-4742-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-4742-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-4742-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

141-413-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-413-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Lively Dirge.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

254-2438--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2

3384-4067-7132.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Your deck size is 8 or greater.
3384-4067-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw eight cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until you have at least {5}{U} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 1.

252-1575-2829-5776.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

49-2034-4871-7057-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

2645-3139-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Great Henge's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3139-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

710-2961-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

141-167-2292.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

804-1621.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima the Impostor.
804-1621.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have Sakashima the Impostor enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2445-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-2445-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

1920-2060-2445-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-2445-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1319-1367.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nexus of Fate from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Brinelin triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1322-1563-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

224-596-3281-4096.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
224-596-3281-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Great Furnace and return Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Darksteel Citadel enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Darksteel Citadel and return Great Furnace from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Furnace enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Great Furnace by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

732-3113-3562.notablePrerequisites:
Fire Whip attached to Felhide Spiritbender.
Felhide Spiritbender does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
732-3113-3562.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Sky Hussar by paying {3}{W}{U}.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Felhide Spiritbender triggers, holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbender trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
The token Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 5.

396-1778-2232.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2205-4275-4852.notablePrerequisites: Imperious Perfect and Elvish Mystic do not have summoning sickness.
2034-2205-4275-4852.description:
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Imperious Perfect by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Faces of the Past, untapping all Elves and Warriors.
Repeat.

851-1589-3182-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three legendary creatures.
851-1589-3182-4050.description:
Activate Sokenzan's second ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Sokenzan ability, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two creatures, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing three creatures, returning Sokenzan from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7-539-730-1899-2232.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-730-1899-2232.description:
Cast Beastcaller Savant for {G}, triggering Emeria Angel and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Emeria Angel's trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token with flying.
The Bird token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Tap Beastcaller Savant, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand.
Repeat.

628-3693.notablePrerequisites: Walking Ballista on the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Walking Ballista dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
